name: Freeze source versions
description: Export V2 Google Sheet to XLSX; store checksum and schema fingerprint; compare with companion XLSX dictionary.

name: Raw acquisition
description: Download/retain immutable source files or HTML snapshots; record URL, download time, checksum, license/access.

name: Source-specific parsing
description: Parse Palestine XLSX, NZ HTML tables, Canada CSVs, India XLS, Nigeria replication files, microdata APIs.

name: Normalize
description: Convert all source records into canonical long schema without losing original source labels/values.

name: Crosswalk approval
description: Human review of source-variable -> canonical mappings and institution universes; assign A/B/C/D.

name: Validation
description: Run schema, key, unit, component, source-universe and provenance checks.

name: Derived measures
description: Compute per-100k rates, turnover, shares, per-prisoner labour/cost only from approved compatible fields.

name: Comparison panels
description: Build synchronous panels: Palestine-NZ; Palestine-Nigeria; Palestine-Canada; India pre-period benchmark.

name: QA report
description: Emit HTML/CSV report of missing years, discrepancies, unapproved mappings, proxy use and source revisions.
